title: Implement a game-free four-slot controller ownership model
goal: Provide an original C++20 host input ownership component with four independent slots, explicit reservations and stale-event rejection, without connecting it to guest input or claiming physical controller support.
acceptance: Use fixed-capacity original code with explicit local-owner/device identities and a caller-owned session identity; do not infer retail player limits, guest addresses, Xbox account identities or SDK button layouts
Require explicit assignment, reject duplicate device/owner bindings and occupied-slot takeover, preserve slot ownership on disconnect, neutralize state, and invalidate stale session/binding events
Validate complete normalized frames before mutation, reject nonfinite/out-of-range values and nonincreasing sequences, and never let another slot or rejected event change unrelated state
Keep the interface single-thread owned, ephemeral and independent of SDL/XInput/SDK/runtime imports; physical/backend and title integration remain separate dependent work
validation: Run original four-slot, disconnect/reconnect, duplicate/takeover, stale-session/token, ordering/wrap and invalid-frame cases with meaningful unchanged-state assertions
Run deterministic repeated/permuted event orders on native Windows/Linux and supported address/undefined sanitizers; record an intentionally wrong-result rejection
Run the public game-free checks and bind compiler/source/test identities; report unavailable physical controllers and unexecuted title/guest mappings explicitly
